name: Rigel
tagline: Orion's blue-white foot — a supergiant among the most luminous stars known.
history: Rigel burns blue-white at Orion's foot — a supergiant pouring out 120,000 Suns' worth of light, bright enough to outshine Sirius across 860 light-years. It is a quadruple system: three faint companions orbit the giant, which itself is shedding mass in a powerful wind and will someday explode as a supernova. Its ultraviolet glare ionizes the nearby Witch Head Nebula, lighting it like a reflection screen.
